title: EEG Trial Geometry And Confound Ledger
claim_target: EEG identity quality and confound qualification only
scientific_claim_ceiling: A future clean execution may establish only the declared identity, target-isolation, signal-quality, event-reconciliation, geometry, reference, and recorded-confound ceiling of the exact S20 block. It cannot establish neural advantage, brain-specific origin, decoding accuracy, real-time operation, portable hardware, home use, or clinical utility.

primary_source_findings.finding: BrainVision Core Data Format separates text header, text marker, and binary signal into VHDR, VMRK, and EEG files. File membership does not make their contents equally target-free.
A marker carries type and description for what happened plus position for when it happened. Marker descriptions can therefore encode labels or task conditions.
The normal MNE BrainVision reader converts marker type and description into Raw annotations. preload=False does not make a VHDR read marker-blind.
EEG channel name, type, unit, order, reference, electrodes, and coordinate system are separate metadata concepts. Unknown fields must not be inferred from a familiar channel label.
Event tables may mix stimuli, participant responses, and other markers. Timing fields and condition or response fields require separate sensitivity treatment.

The published EEG cohort used 61 EEG and three ocular channels at 1 kHz, two 64-sentence blocks per session, and keypress-aligned windows. Those cohort facts do not verify this S20 file and do not establish a local neural result.

findings.finding: mne.io.read_raw_brainvision is called on VHDR and exposes VMRK-derived annotations through raw.annotations.
Channels whose names contain EOG are excluded before extraction, removing a required peripheral control.
VMRK annotations and MAT trigger records are consumed in the same extraction invocation as signal access.
scipy.io.loadmat materializes the companion MAT payload before field-level target isolation.
Plaintext labels and trial indices are written into the produced cache.

current_warnings: The published 61 EEG plus three ocular channel configuration is a cohort-level method fact, not verified S20 file metadata.
The normal MNE BrainVision reader is not eligible for a VHDR-only target-free stage because it attaches marker-derived annotations.
The current legacy extractor removes EOG-named channels and co-loads VMRK, MAT, signal, and labels.
BrainVision marker descriptions can reveal event or key identity; marker access is target-bearing.
A clean Loop 54 result would qualify one S20 block only and would not itself be a decoding result.
